CommunityApplications.Profile:
JPetovello's Repository provides Unraid Docker applications focused on practical self-hosted tools and monitoring.
Current applications include X-ONU-SFPP Dashboard for monitoring EXEN X-ONU-SFPP and compatible XGS-PON ONTs running 8311 community firmware, and PassForge for privacy-focused password analysis and secure passphrase generation.
Project source code, documentation, and issue tracking are available through the individual application repositories on GitHub.
